s: Dine shittup beerub ubo t' seipim: maboy hammetuqqan belechi, veen tzarik lomar betzurat petach — reshut hayyachid gemura hi min hattora, vaapillu hammetuqqan beqora, sheenah kimchitztza ella mishshum hekker beolma. Ukeshehammaboy patuach lirshut harabbim eno reshut hayyachid min hattora, kemo shennitbaer besimman shm"h, mikkol maqom min hattora eno ella meqom petur, umuttar lehotzi ulehaknis mimmennu lachatzerot ap al pi shehen reshut hayyachid gemura. Ella shechakamim aseru lehotzi ulehaknis mimmennu lachatzerot, mippene shehachatzerot hen meyuchadot kol achat libaleha vehammaboy meshuttap lekullam, vedomeh qetzat lirshut harabbim, veim yotziu mechatzerot lemaboy — yomru shemmuttar lehotzi mereshut hayyachid lirshut harabbim. Abal hittiru al yede shittup, sheggobin pat o dabar acher mimmine maakal o mashqeh mikkol chatzer vechatzer, venotenim oto beachat mehachatzerot, veanu roim keillu patuach kol hammaboy leotah chatzer bilbaddah, shekkol hachatzerot shebbammaboy naasu keachat al yede shittup zeh. Veen shittup zeh domeh leerub sheeno ella bepat bilbad, lepi sheerube chatzerot hu mishshum dira, leareb diratam laasotan keachat, vedirato shel adam enah nimsheket ella achar meqom pitto. Abal shittup shebbammaboy eno ella leshattep hachatzerot velo habbattim, vechatzer lav bet dira hi. Lepikak en tzarik lehanniach hashshittup bebayit harauy ledira kemo erube chatzerot, ella yekolim lehannicho apillu bebayit sheen bo d' ammot al d' ammot, o bebet shaar aksadra umirpeset, o apillu baavir hechatzer bemaqom hammishtammer, kevan sheeno ella leshittup hachatzerot. Abal en mannichim oto baavir maboy, mippene sheeno maqom hammishtammer, vehu haddin bekol maqom sheeno mishtammer:

Hashshittup tzarik lihyot munnach bechatzer shebbemaboy zeh, abal lo shebbemaboy acher shello nishtattep im zeh. Lepikak yisreelim sheddarim beb' veg' meqomot chaluqim urechoqim zeh mizzeh, shemmapsiq benehem maqom haasur betiltul mippene sheeno metuqqan belechi o qora o tzurat petach, o mippene sheddarim sham nokrim velo sakeru mehem reshutam, vehashshammash gobeh qemach mikkullam veoseh mimmennu erub echad, venoteno bemaqom echad mehem — eno moil lahem, ella tzerikim leareb bekol maqom umaqom bipne atzmo (veim erebu bemaqom echad, ubemaqom echad lo erebu — yitbaer besimman shtz"b), shehare i epshar lahem lehishtattep yachad, kevan sheasurim letaltel mizzeh lezeh, veim ken i epshar leshattep maqom zeh vesheyyehe hashshittup munnach bemaqom acher sheeno meshuttap immo:

Kekol mishpete erube chatzerot veshiuro, vesheishto mearebet bishbilo, veshemmeorbin shello ladaat im en habbayit patuach ella lechatzer a', vesheqqatan yakol ligbot et haerub, vesheyyakol echad lizakkot lekullam, vesheim hayu shuttapim bappat enam tzerikim leareb — kak dine shittup. Vaapillu im haya meshuttap im shekenayv bischora, lezeh beyayin ulezeh beshemen — enam tzerikim lehishtattep, vehu sheyyihyu hashshemen vehayyayin bikli echad, kemo sheerube chatzerot tzarik lihyot bikli echad:

Mishtattepim bekol mine maakal, vaapillu d' veHashem mine maakal mitztorpin limzon b' seuddot, shehu shiur hashshittup bitchillato apillu leelep bene adam, kemo shennitbaer beerube chatzerot. Bekol mine maakal meorbin, chutz miggudgedaniyyot shehuqshu lezera utebalin upolin yebeshim, velo baale habbetzalim shello gadelu orek hazzeret, velo bikmehin upitriyyot velo bekapniyyot velo baadashim chayyin velo bechittim useorim chayyin velo beyaraq shehu bashil velo bashil, mippene shekkol ellu enan reuyim laakila. Abal beyaraq chay mishtattepim kemo sheyyitbaer, vehu haddin lepatot shellanu shenneekalin gam ken chayyin, veenam geruim mibbasar chay shemmishtattepim bo kemo sheyyitbaer:

Bekol mine mashqim mishtattepim, chutz min hammayim lebaddam veken melach lebaddo, lepi sheenan zanin haggup kelal, abal im ereb mayim umelach beyachad — mazon hu letabbe(v)l bo pitto, umishtattepim bahem:

Kol dabar shergilim lelappet bo et happat, shiuro kede lelappet bo pat hanneekal leb' seuddot, shehen keshishsha betzim, kemo shennitbaer besimman shs"ch. Vekol dabar sheen melappetin bo et happat, shiuro kede leekol mimmennu beatzmo b' seuddot. Ubasar chay eno rauy leliptan, vetzarik kede leekol mimmennu b' seuddot. Vehu sheyyehe maliach, vehu haddin ledag maliach. Abal basar tzali — liptan hu, veshiuro kede lelappet bo b' seuddot. Vaapillu im yesh kamma bene adam sheokelim belo pat — botla datam etzel kol adam. Vechometz — shiuro kede letabbel bo yaraq mezon b' seuddot, im haya okel hayyaraq lebaddo belo pat. Veyayin mebushshal — leqinnuach seudda hu ba (velo letabbel), lepikak shiuro kede shemmebiim mimmennu leqinnuach b' seuddot. Veken kol kayyotze bazeh. Veyayin chay — shiuro b' rebiiyyot, lishtot rebiit bekol seudda, veken shiur shear kol hammashqim:

Mishtattepim bishne betzim, apillu chayyin, bishne rimmonim, bachamishsha aparseqin (baasara egozim veetrog echad), belitra yaraq ben chay ben mebushshal, bepolin lachim melo hayyad, betappuche yaar melo haqqab (vehu haddin letappuche pardes), veken temarim o gerogarot melo haqqab udebela mishqal maneh (vehu litra):

Mishtattepin apillu beokel sheeno rauy lo, im rauy leshum adam miyyisrael, kegon lenazir beyayin uleyisrael bitruma bizman shehayeta neekelet lakkohanim. Abal akshav en teruma tehora reuya leshum adam, shekkullanu temee metim, sheen lanu eper para. Veken hannoder meokel o nishba shello yoklennu mishtattep bo, kevan sherauy leyisrael acher. Vaapillu nadar venishba shello yehaneh mimmennu lo neesar bo bahanaa zo mah shemmishtattep bo, lepi shello nitkavven ella shello lehanot mimmennu bederek hanaato. Veyesh omerim shehannoder meokel, apillu lo nadar ella meakilato velo mehanaato — eno mishtattep bo, lepi shehannoder hu sheoser et hachepetz alayv, sheomer "qonam okel peloni alay", dehaynu sheoto okel yehe neesar alayv keqorban, umitchallep hu beheqdesh, shehaheqdesh hu gam ken shehachepetz mitqaddesh veneesar al haadam; ubeheqdesh ledibre hakkol en mishtattepim, lepi sheeno rauy leshum adam. Veyesh lehachamir kedibrehem. Amar "kikkar zo hayyom chol, ulemachar tehe qodesh" o "qonam" — mishtattep bah, shebben hashshemashot adayin lo nitqaddesha vadday, umissapeq lo chal aleha qedushsha leinyan erub veshittup. Veap al pi shei epshar leoklah ben hashshemashot, shehi sheat qeniyyat haerub vehashshittup, mikkol maqom kevan sheruya laakila mibbeod yom, vegam beben hashshemashot lo chal aleha qedushsha vaddait adayin, meorbin lo bah. Abal im amar "hayyom qodesh ulemachar chol, shettehe mechullelet al maot sheyyesh li" — en meorbin umishtattepim bah, shemmissapeq lo nipqea qedushsha, vahare enah reuya ad shettechshak:

Chatzer happetucha leb' meboot, veshittepa im shenehem — mutteret bishnehem, letaltel mibbatteha lekol achat mehem, ubilbad shello tetaltel kelim sheshshabetu beechad mibbatte maboy zeh lemaboy hab' derek chatzerah, shehare hammeboot lo shittepu yachad. Veim natenu b' hammeboot shittupam bechatzer zo bikli echad — hare kullam meshuttapim yachad, kemo shennitbaer besimman sha"ch, umuttar letaltel mizzeh lezeh. Veim lo shittepa im shum achat mehem, im hi regila bishnehem latzet velabo bechol derek alehem — oseret al shenehem. Veim regila beachat ubashsheni enah regila, zeh shergila bo — oseret, vezeh sheenah regila bo — enah oseret, ap al pi sheoberet alayv beshabbat. Veim shittepa im zeh sheenah regila bo — huttar haragil leatzmo im shittepu benehem, shekkevan shechatzer zo shittepa im hashsheni, hare silleqa atzmah mizzeh shehayeta regila bo veenah. Veen tzarik lomar im regila bishnehem veshittepa im achat mehem, shehuttar hashsheni leatzmo im shittepu benehem. Veim hammaboy shergila bo shittepu benehem, veoto sheenah regila bo lo shittepu benehem, vehi lo shittepa lo im zeh velo im zeh — dochin otah etzel zeh sheenah regila bo shello nishtattep, vetistalleq mizzeh shergila bo shennishtattep, shello taabor alayv beshabbat, kede sheyyehe muttar leatzmo. Kevan shehi enah mapsedet baddabar, shehare lo shittepa immo vaasura lehishtammesh bo, veyesh revach laacherim, sheal yede zeh yihyu muttarim lehishtammesh bammaboy — kopin otah al middat sedom, shettaabor beshabbat derek maboy shello nishtattep, ap al pi sheenah regila bo. Veen tzarik lomar im regila gam bo, sheen lah laabor beshabbat al hashsheni shennishtattep veleesor alayv. Velo ameru shehaabara beregel lebad beli tashmish enah oseret ella bb' chatzerot zo lipnim mizzo, sheen happenimit oseret al hachitzona behaabarat ragleha aleha lebad, hoil veiqqar chatzer chitzona hu letashmish bene chitzona. Abal hammaboy, hoil vetashmisho shaveh lekol hachatzerot haregilot bo — hare hen oserot zo al zo apillu behaabara beregel lebad beshabbat, ap al pi shemmesalleqet et atzmah millehishtammesh bo mechamat issur, mippene shello erebu yachad. Abal chatzer shessilleqa atzmah millehishtammesh bemaboy, veosta maaseh hammokiach al silluqah — shebbonta itzteba gaboah d' tepachim al pitchah — shub enah oseret al bene hammaboy ap al pi sheoberet derek alehem beshabbat, vaapillu en lah petach lemaboy acher laabor derek alayv lirshut harabbim:
